title: The transcript-reader rule runs in npm run fast on every src change
body:
Why: on 2026-11-14 the refactor-scripts lane (t-5wzk8zf) added src/harness/memory-directory.ts; npm run fast passed and the Check went red (74) on the tree-wide rule in test/harness/transcripts.test.ts, which fast selects only by import.
Outcome: the src-wide transcript-reader rule lives under test/rules/, which npm run fast runs on every change.
Proof: node --test test/rules/transcript-readers.test.ts PASS; npm run fast PASS.
